# Logo System

**Masters:** workspace `logo/` (official PNG + SVG)  
**Web exports:** `platform/public/brand/` (generated by `pnpm` / `python scripts/export_brand_assets.py`)  
**Rules:** Brand Guidelines Volume II + Volume IV

## Official master inventory

| File | Role |
| ---- | ---- |
| `VM_Logo.png` / `.svg` | Primary lockup — monogram + wordmark + tagline on purple |
| `VM_Logo1.png` / `.svg` | Icon tile — monogram on purple (app icon / avatar) |
| `VM_Logo2.png` / `.svg` | Monogram — gold on black |
| `VM_Logo3.png` / `.svg` | Additional approved variant |

> Note: The supplied `.svg` masters are **PNG-in-SVG** (embedded base64 rasters), not path-based vectors. That is why master SVGs are 0.5–6 MB. Web assets re-embed a resized PNG or ship WebP so quality stays photographic while payloads stay usable.

## Web assets (`public/brand/`)

| Asset | Use |
| ----- | --- |
| `vm-icon.svg` | Favicon / metadata icon (official art, ~512px embed) |
| `vm-monogram.svg` | SVG monogram for seals / dark surfaces |
| `vm-lockup.svg` | Full lockup SVG |
| `vm-icon-512.webp` | In-app header/shell mark (preferred) |
| `vm-monogram-512.webp` | Footer / dark chrome |
| `vm-lockup-1024.webp` | Marketing / hero moments |
| `apple-touch-icon.png` | iOS home screen (180×180) |
| `og-default.webp` | Open Graph / Twitter share (1200×630) |

Regenerate after logo updates:

```bash
cd platform
python scripts/export_brand_assets.py
```

## Clear space & size (Volume II)

| Rule | Value |
| ---- | ----- |
| Minimum clear space | Equal to the width of the **V** stem |
| Minimum digital icon | **24px** |
| Minimum full logo | **120px** wide |

## Usage rules

**Do**

- Use official artwork from `logo/` → export pipeline only  
- Prefer cream or white quiet space around the mark  
- Use approved purple / gold / charcoal / cream  

**Don’t**

- Stretch, rotate, or distort  
- Recolor outside the approved system  
- Bundle uncompressed 10–40 MB masters into `platform/public`  
- Attach the tagline to every UI chrome instance  

## Component

`components/layout/brand-mark.tsx` — `BrandMark` with `icon` | `monogram` | `lockup` variants.
